name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
title: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd - 533080 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Capacity utilisation is only about 68% (43,000 of 63,000 tonnes) with FY27 capex cut to INR80-85 crore, while EBITDA/kg guidance rises to 42.5 from 40.7 and EBITDA is targeted at INR210 crore from INR173 crore.

utilisation.quote: capacity is 63,000 tons and utilization is hardly 43,000

capex.quote: we hope to control this capex to INR80 crores, INR85 crores in the next year, that is '26-'27 as we will be going only for brownfield expansions now onwards.

triggers.label: FY27 capex cut to INR80-85 cr
triggers.quote: we hope to control this capex to INR80 crores, INR85 crores in the next year

triggers.label: Utilisation ~68% (43k of 63k t)
triggers.quote: capacity is 63,000 tons and utilization is hardly 43,000

triggers.label: Full raw-material pass-through
triggers.quote: we have passed on the entire price rise to the clients across the segments

triggers.label: Clients returning on supply reliability
triggers.quote: we are finding our clients coming back in herds

triggers.label: Debtor and inventory days stretched
triggers.quote: debtor days and inventory days are stretched a bit

triggers.label: Lubes lost BPCL PSU business
triggers.quote: We lost a client BPCL towards the end of last financial year

guidance.quote: we are aiming at, at least 42 to 43, 42.5 could be a good estimate for the full year
we are aiming at, at least INR210 crores EBITDA for next financial year, up from INR173
we hope that we will be somewhere between 13% to 15% in the value growth in the next financial year
The volume growth is 10% to 13% because Pharma won't add volumes.
to reach somewhere around INR50 crores to INR55 crores for the next financial year
We are planning it will be in the region of around INR80 crores to INR85 crores overall.
probably the ROCE will start looking at around 15% by '27-'28

red_flags.label: Debtor and inventory days stretching
red_flags.quote: debtor days and inventory days are stretched a bit

red_flags.label: Lube volume loss from PSU tender pricing
red_flags.quote: We couldn't match their pricing and we let it go.

red_flags.label: One-time other expenses from maintenance
red_flags.quote: there's a onetime expansion in the maintenance cost that is preventive in nature

evasions.quote: I have no detailed discussion. I mean, EBITDA kg of each segment

evasions.quote: With Grasim and without Grasim, I don't have the figures readily available
